title: ObjectTypes
description: Data files content/objects/*.json: object types and their TRUE properties (the world knows the truth, inhabitants only believe). A property not listed is false. Values are data (placeholders until Marcel decides).

description.description: Short English meaning for docs and prompts; never shown to the player.

ObjectParams.description: Optional number parameters of a type (B5 R8, D634): physics the core reads, never a behaviour. Integers only (determinism). A missing field means the type has no such effect. Placeholders until the TL sets them (B2649).

insulation_tenth_c.description: Felt temperature gained while worn or wrapped in it, in tenths of a degree (B5-2, R4).

wind_block_permille.description: Share of the wind kept off someone right next to it, in permille (B5-2, R4).

shade_height_cm.description: Height of the shade-casting part above the ground, in centimetres (B5-2, D634 R29).

crown_radius_cm.description: Radius of the shade-casting part, in centimetres (B5-2, D634 R29).

burn_minutes.description: How long one piece burns as fuel, in game minutes (B5-2, R7, D634 R45).

heat_tenth_c.description: Felt temperature added right at the source while it burns or glows, in tenths of a degree; it falls off with distance by a data table (B5-2, R4, R7).

heat_radius_cm.description: Distance up to which the heat is felt, in centimetres (B5-2, R7).

light_radius_cm.description: Radius it lights, in centimetres (B5-2b, D634 R44).

light_permille.description: Strength of the light at the source, in permille of daylight (B5-2b, D634 R44).

tool_value_permille.description: How good it is as a tool, in permille; an input of the build quality (B5-7, D634 R38).
